whyItMatters: csharp file access assembles paths from input (File.ReadAllText(dir + f)), so traversal sequences escape the intended directory.
actions: Confine the resolved path under its base directory with Path.GetFullPath plus prefix check and reject escapes.
Prefer an allowlist mapping opaque input ids to fixed paths.
Re-run the scan and confirm no assembled path remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no assembled path reachable from untrusted input, and traversal probes are rejected.
